notes: Names and descriptions are the official PSN text (via Exophase, cross-checked with PSNProfiles and TrueAchievements). Guides are written in our own words; difficulty, time and missable notes follow PowerPyx's GTA 6 trophy guide and roadmap. 27 trophies are visible on PSN, 28 are hidden until earned.

sources.name: Planet GTA 6 — GTA 6 Trophies (Exophase / PSNProfiles / TrueAchievements)

trophies.guide: The platinum pops automatically once the other 54 trophies are earned. There is no extra task behind it, so treat it as the finish line of the roadmap below rather than a trophy to chase on its own.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
sources: Planet GTA 6 — GTA 6 Trophies (Exophase / PSNProfiles / TrueAchievements)

trophies.guide: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, through to the end. It is the first story mission, so this pops naturally in the opening hour with no preparation needed.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
sources: Planet GTA 6 — GTA 6 Trophies (Exophase / PSNProfiles / TrueAchievements)

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 1 and the chapter trophy pops. Before you move on, meditate at the Chapter 1 balcony spot: PowerPyx flags it as the one meditation that can be lost after the chapter, and there is no mission replay.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost
sources: Planet GTA 6 — GTA 6 Trophies (Exophase / PSNProfiles / TrueAchievements)

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2 in full. By now both protagonists are playable, so most of the open-world list opens up: start scanning vehicles and studying animals as you travel between missions.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
sources: Planet GTA 6 — GTA 6 Trophies (Exophase / PSNProfiles / TrueAchievements)

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. Side content you skipped earlier is still available in free roam, so use the gaps between story beats to chip away at races, challenges and collectibles.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
sources: Planet GTA 6 — GTA 6 Trophies (Exophase / PSNProfiles / TrueAchievements)

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4. You are close to the finale now, so make a manual save at the start of the chapter: there is no mission replay and no New Game Plus.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
sources: Planet GTA 6 — GTA 6 Trophies (Exophase / PSNProfiles / TrueAchievements)

trophies.guide: Complete the final mission. Make a manual save before it: with no mission replay, this is your one shot at the ending on this save, and free roam continues afterwards for cleanup.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
sources: Planet GTA 6 — GTA 6 Trophies (Exophase / PSNProfiles / TrueAchievements)

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Breakfast Run. This is a story-only trophy: it pops when the mission ends, so just play through it.
trophies.name: Trust
sources: Planet GTA 6 — GTA 6 Trophies (Exophase / PSNProfiles / TrueAchievements)

trophies.guide: Complete The Cartel Heist. A story heist: follow the mission objectives to the end and the trophy pops with the getaway.
trophies.name: Break the Bank
sources: Planet GTA 6 — GTA 6 Trophies (Exophase / PSNProfiles / TrueAchievements)

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Child's Play. Story-only: it unlocks when the mission is finished.
trophies.name: Family Matters
sources: Planet GTA 6 — GTA 6 Trophies (Exophase / PSNProfiles / TrueAchievements)

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Headliners. Story-only: it unlocks when the mission is finished.
trophies.name: DWNFALL
sources: Planet GTA 6 — GTA 6 Trophies (Exophase / PSNProfiles / TrueAchievements)

trophies.guide: Complete the mission VCIA Takedown. Story-only: it unlocks when the mission is finished.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
sources: Planet GTA 6 — GTA 6 Trophies (Exophase / PSNProfiles / TrueAchievements)

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory. Story-only: it unlocks when the mission is finished.
trophies.name: Snow Storm
sources: Planet GTA 6 — GTA 6 Trophies (Exophase / PSNProfiles / TrueAchievements)

trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion on the in-game checklist (Progress, then Stats). PowerPyx notes the thresholds are lenient, roughly 60% of true completion: any 70 of 80 challenges, 200 of 277 vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied. The checklist itself only appears after the story, but earlier progress counts, and most of it is earned by doing the other trophies.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. Stunts are the jumps, near-misses and airtime the game tracks as you drive: chain them on highways, ramps and jumps in free roam and the count climbs steadily across a full playthrough.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once. Sample everything: racing, fishing, the shooting range, the arcade, drone races, meditation, hunting and the rest. One go at each is enough, so this is an early, easy trophy if you dip into each activity as you find it.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Learn each range's weapon and scoring, replay the ones you miss, and keep your aim steady: the gold thresholds are the only bar, and you can retry a challenge as often as you like.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every one of the 14 locations. Learn each course's racing line, then win them one by one: there is no need to win them all in one sitting.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Enter a mix of street, off-road and water races: each distinct race you win counts once, so spread out across the map rather than repeating one favourite.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fish the challenge spot, watch the line tension and reel timing, and keep at it until you outscore him: fishing challenges can be retried.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Walk into any arcade, pick a cabinet, and play it through to the end: one finished game is all it takes.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Work through Andy's mission strand as it appears across Leonida, and the trophy pops at the end of his last mission.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
sources: Planet GTA 6 — GTA 6 Trophies (Exophase / PSNProfiles / TrueAchievements)

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Follow Kenton's mission strand to its end; the trophy pops when his last mission is done.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
sources: Planet GTA 6 — GTA 6 Trophies (Exophase / PSNProfiles / TrueAchievements)

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Follow Billy's mission strand to its end; the trophy pops when his last mission is done.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider
sources: Planet GTA 6 — GTA 6 Trophies (Exophase / PSNProfiles / TrueAchievements)

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Stranger missions appear as you explore; take them when you see them and follow each strand to its end. Eight completed strands is the bar, and the character strands (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone) count towards it.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Follow Randy's mission strand to its end; the trophy pops when his last mission is done.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand
sources: Planet GTA 6 — GTA 6 Trophies (Exophase / PSNProfiles / TrueAchievements)

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Follow Tyrone's mission strand to its end; the trophy pops when his last mission is done.
trophies.name: Spin On This!
sources: Planet GTA 6 — GTA 6 Trophies (Exophase / PSNProfiles / TrueAchievements)

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida: 18 spots in 10 locations, with both Jason and Lucia. PowerPyx flags this as the only possibly missable trophy: the Chapter 1 balcony meditation can be lost after that chapter, and there is no mission replay, so meditate at every spot the moment you find it and keep a manual save at the start of each chapter.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Track the animal Bret points you to, study it through the binoculars first if you can, and take the shot cleanly.
trophies.name: Fair Game
sources: Planet GTA 6 — GTA 6 Trophies (Exophase / PSNProfiles / TrueAchievements)

trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Cards are scattered across Leonida; collect full sets and the trophy pops on the third completed set. Pick up every card you pass while doing other trophies.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Use WAiNK It at 100 locations. WAiNK is the in-game camera check-in: open it at landmarks, viewpoints and points of interest as you travel, until you reach 100. It pairs naturally with exploring all of Leonida.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Challenges cover driving, combat, exploration and more; 50 of the 80 is the bar, and the 100% checklist needs 70, so work through the easiest ones first and skip the hardest until later.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted level with your partner and escape the heat. Build heat with your partner beside you, then break line of sight and stay out of the search area until the stars clear.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted level. Pick three shops close together, keep each robbery quick, and do not let the wanted level drop between them.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. The game logs each new vehicle you drive or scan; drive everything you see and scan new models. Only 100 of 277 are needed, and the same progress feeds the 100% checklist, which wants 200.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Trigger Combat Focus in a busy fight, line up clustered enemies, and drop five before the effect ends.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA, the Vice City airport. Find a way out that is not on the timetable: a fast vehicle down a runway does the job.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
sources: Planet GTA 6 — GTA 6 Trophies (Exophase / PSNProfiles / TrueAchievements)

trophies.guide: Deal with Rhinos, the military tanks. The description is deliberately vague, so expect to face Rhinos in a late-game encounter and come out on top.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank
sources: Planet GTA 6 — GTA 6 Trophies (Exophase / PSNProfiles / TrueAchievements)

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet: avoid cameras and sightlines, keep the robbery fast, and leave before anyone raises the alarm.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Plan each vault job, grab the take, and get clear of the wanted level: five clean getaways is the bar.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Ambush a truck on the road, crack it open, and outrun the response: a fast getaway car and a planned route make it far easier.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida. The game tracks the regions you have visited, so sweep the coast, the city, the swamps and the countryside: driving the map end to end while doing other trophies covers most of it.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang. Find each gang's off-the-books operation and hit them all: one per gang is the requirement.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to the beachfront bar, order a drink, and take in the view: a quiet moment trophy, not a challenge.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…
sources: Planet GTA 6 — GTA 6 Trophies (Exophase / PSNProfiles / TrueAchievements)

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive a showroom car straight through the glass and out the front: the old-school way out.
trophies.name: Capital Offense
sources: Planet GTA 6 — GTA 6 Trophies (Exophase / PSNProfiles / TrueAchievements)

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Play a full game at the alley and finish it: one completed game is enough.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
sources: Planet GTA 6 — GTA 6 Trophies (Exophase / PSNProfiles / TrueAchievements)

trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. Build your partnership's standing until it peaks: the description is vague by design, so expect it to pop from a story or side beat about the duo.
trophies.name: Personal Best
sources: Planet GTA 6 — GTA 6 Trophies (Exophase / PSNProfiles / TrueAchievements)

trophies.guide: Make 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile. The profile shifts with what you do in the world, so the count builds up over normal play. PowerPyx warns against pushing toward the Irredeemable profile: it is permanent.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. Fail at something, then succeed on the retry: a light, situational trophy that pops when a second attempt lands.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
sources: Planet GTA 6 — GTA 6 Trophies (Exophase / PSNProfiles / TrueAchievements)

trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? Find one of Leonida's strangest encounters: the kind of odd, out-of-the-way event the game hides off the beaten path.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
sources: Planet GTA 6 — GTA 6 Trophies (Exophase / PSNProfiles / TrueAchievements)

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. Score a strike's worth of knockdowns with a melee attack from a moving vehicle: line up a group, swing as you pass, and keep the speed up.
trophies.name: Ten Pin
sources: Planet GTA 6 — GTA 6 Trophies (Exophase / PSNProfiles / TrueAchievements)

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies and jobs: funnel them through your contacts and the total adds up over the course of the game.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Buy clothes, weapons, vehicles and upgrades: spending across every shop type counts toward the total, and it adds up fast once you start kitting out.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties. Buy every garage on the market: they also give you somewhere to store the vehicles you register for On the Spot.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Open the app, register vehicles you own or find, and repeat until you hit 10.
trophies.name: On the Spot
